mxCell.value: Storage model: In-memory (formal audit lifecycle). This is the internal audit engagement system (separate from the audit-service HTTP event log). State persisted to Lakehouse/Kafka.

AuditPlan ---------------------- plan_id (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) plan_year (int) plan_name (varchar) objectives ([]string) scope (varchar) risk_based (bool) status (varchar: draft/approved/active/closed) prepared_by / approved_by (varchar) approval_date (timestamp) engagements ([]AuditEngagement) created_at / updated_at

AuditEngagement ---------------------- engagement_id (varchar) plan_id (FK -> AuditPlan) tenant_id (varchar) title / scope (varchar) audit_type (varchar: financial/operational/compliance/IT) status (varchar: planning/fieldwork/reporting/closed) lead_auditor_id / auditor_ids ([]varchar) auditee_department (varchar) planned_start / planned_end (date) actual_start / actual_end (date) risk_rating (varchar: low/medium/high/critical) objectives / methodology (text) created_at / updated_at

AuditFinding ---------------------- finding_id (varchar) engagement_id (FK -> AuditEngagement) tenant_id (varchar) title / description (text) finding_type (varchar: control_deficiency/fraud/policy_violation) risk_rating (varchar: low/medium/high/critical) root_cause / impact (text) recommendation (text) management_response (text) action_plan / action_owner (varchar) due_date (date) status (varchar: open/in_progress/closed/overdue) closed_at / created_at

ControlTest ---------------------- test_id (varchar) engagement_id (FK -> AuditEngagement) tenant_id (varchar) control_name / control_objective (varchar) control_type (varchar: preventive/detective/corrective) test_procedure (text) sample_size (int) status (varchar: not_started/in_progress/completed) result (varchar: effective/ineffective/partially_effective) exceptions_found (int) tested_by / tested_at evidence_refs ([]varchar) created_at

AuditReport ---------------------- report_id (varchar) engagement_id (FK -> AuditEngagement) tenant_id (varchar) report_type (varchar: interim/final/follow_up) executive_summary (text) overall_rating (varchar) total_findings (int) critical/high/medium/low_findings (int) status (varchar: draft/issued/acknowledged) issued_by / issued_at acknowledged_by / acknowledged_at created_at

FollowUp ---------------------- followup_id (varchar) finding_id (FK -> AuditFinding) tenant_id (varchar) followup_date (date) status (varchar: open/closed/overdue) comments (text) evidence_refs ([]varchar) reviewed_by / reviewed_at created_at
